milestones.demo: Deploy a project declaring one [deploy.services.app] (source=build, port=3000, url='example.com') end-to-end: build → image pushed → compose rendered with auto /healthz healthcheck + .env.app → app up on Caddy. The legacy single-service monorepo consumer is migrated to the new per-service schema, greenfield, with every commit leaving the suite green.

tasks.title: Parse and validate [deploy.services.<name>] additively beside legacy image
tasks.done_when: Config carries services: Record<string, UserServiceConfig> populated from [deploy.services.*] (or synthesized {app:…} from legacy [deploy.image]); both shapes parse; full suite green.
tasks.description:
WHAT — Add UserServiceConfig = ServiceCommon & (BuildServiceConfig | UpstreamServiceConfig) discriminated on `source`, plus ServiceCommon { port?, url?, secrets?, needs?, depends_on? }. Add `services: Record<string, UserServiceConfig>` to HetznerVpsDeploySection ADDITIVELY — keep `image: DeployImageConfig` for now. Add validateServices in validation/deploy.ts walking [deploy.services.<name>] sub-tables: KEBAB instance name, port default 3000, source discriminator (build → context/dockerfile/target optional, target defaults to name, ref/registry_auth_secret rejected; upstream → ref required, build fields rejected). In M1 reject >1 service (temporary, lifted M2.A-01). When no [deploy.services.*] is present, SYNTHESIZE services = { app: { source: image.source, …image fields } } from the legacy [deploy.image] result so every consumer can already read `services`. Wire through providers/hetzner.ts.

WHY — D1 + D2: the parser is the gate to a clean typed shape; making `services` additive + synthesized-from-legacy lets every downstream task migrate off `image` one commit at a time without ever red-chaining the suite (the legacy field is dropped in M1.A-05).

WHERE — packages/infrastructure/src/config/types.ts; packages/infrastructure/src/config/validation/deploy.ts; packages/infrastructure/src/config/validation/providers/hetzner.ts; packages/infrastructure/src/config/fixtures

DONE WHEN —
- Fixture [deploy.services.app] source=build → parses; port defaults to 3000; HetznerVpsDeploySection.services.app present
- Fixtures using legacy [deploy.image] / defaults → services.app synthesized; existing config/load.test.ts assertions still pass
- source=build + ref → error; source=upstream without ref → error; two [deploy.services.*] → error (M1 stub)
- pnpm --filter @nextnode-solutions/infrastructure test green

tasks.title: Emit per-service image_refs JSON and bake_targets beside legacy image_ref
tasks.done_when: compute-image-ref writes bake_targets CSV + image_refs JSON Record<service, ImageRef> AND keeps the legacy image_ref output; suite green.
tasks.description:
WHAT — Extend computeImageRef in domain/deploy/image-ref.ts with an optional service-suffix arg so it can produce ghcr.io/<owner>/<repo>-<service>:<sha>. In compute-image-ref.command.ts iterate config.deploy.services: for source='build' compute the suffixed ImageRef; for source='upstream' parse service.ref via parseImageRef. Emit two NEW GITHUB_OUTPUT entries: bake_targets='<csv of build services>' and image_refs=<JSON Record<service, ImageRef>>. KEEP emitting the legacy single `image_ref` output (additive) so deploy.yml stays green until M1.A-04 switches it over.

WHY — D4: a single multi-target bake needs the explicit build-target list; downstream jobs consume the full Record. Keeping image_ref additive preserves the green pipeline contract during the migration.

WHERE — packages/infrastructure/src/cli/deploy/compute-image-ref.command.ts; packages/infrastructure/src/domain/deploy/image-ref.ts

DONE WHEN —
- Single-service fixture: bake_targets='app', image_refs='{"app":{…}}', image_ref still emitted (= app's ref)
- Mixed fixture (front=build, api=build, worker=upstream): bake_targets='front,api', image_refs has 3 entries, worker ref verbatim
- compute-image-ref.command.test.ts updated for the new outputs; suite green

tasks.title: Render compose per service with auto /healthz and matching per-service env file
tasks.done_when: renderComposeFile loops services emitting image, env_file ['.env.<name>'], /healthz healthcheck, ports only for url services; stageRollout writes .env.<name>; bringUpApp drops the `app` filter; suite green.
tasks.description:
WHAT — Change ComposeFileInput from { image, hostPort } to { services: Record<string, UserServiceConfig>, images: Record<string, ImageRef>, hostPorts: Record<string, number> } and loop: per user service emit image: formatImageRef(images[name]), restart 'unless-stopped', env_file ['.env.<name>'], ports ['127.0.0.1:<hostPorts[name]>:<port>'] ONLY when url is set, healthcheck { test ['CMD','wget','-q','-O-','http://localhost:<port>/healthz'], interval '10s', timeout '3s', retries 6 }. Backing groups (postgres, supabase) unchanged. Thread `services` into DeployContainerInput; in stageRollout (adapters/hetzner/deploy-container.ts) build the single-entry records { app: … } from the still-single image/hostPort inputs (the Record source is switched in M1.A-04), write /opt/apps/<project>/<env>/.env.app via formatComposeEnv, drop the shared `.env` write. In bringUpApp replace `up -d --remove-orphans app` with `up -d --remove-orphans`. Update converge-vps/target callers to pass `services`.

WHY — D5 (per-service env file is the isolation unit; path must match env_file) + D7 (mandatory /healthz contract; bring-up delegated to the compose daemon). Loop body is the M2/M3 foundation.

WHERE — packages/infrastructure/src/domain/hetzner/compose-file.ts; packages/infrastructure/src/adapters/hetzner/deploy-container.ts; packages/infrastructure/src/adapters/hetzner/target.ts

DONE WHEN —
- Single-service fixture renders app with /healthz healthcheck + env_file ['.env.app']; service with url → ports entry, without url → none
- stageRollout writes .env.app (no shared .env); bringUpApp issues `up -d --remove-orphans` with no positional service
- Existing backing fixtures (postgres, supabase) render identically; compose-file.test.ts + deploy-container.test.ts updated; suite green

WHAT — Add parseImageRefsEnv (JSON.parse + per-entry ImageRef validation). In resolve-deploy-context.ts replace image: parseImageRef(requireEnv('IMAGE_REF')) with images: parseImageRefsEnv(requireEnv('IMAGE_REFS')). Rename DeployInput.image → DeployInput.images: Record<string, ImageRef> (domain/deploy/target.ts), thread through DeployContainerInput, and have stageRollout pass the Record straight to renderComposeFile (signature ready since M1.A-03). tasks.title: Validate url uniqueness and project.domain ownership
tasks.done_when: Two services sharing a url → error; a url not equal to nor a sub-domain of project.domain → error; sub-domain passes; suite green.
